description: Evaluates the reviewer stage against real vulnerabilities and the 13 triage rejection rules (sample test code, generic hygiene, unreachable code, client-side only enforcement).

finding.title: SQL injection via unescaped search parameter in user directory query
finding.description: Direct string interpolation in SELECT statement allowing arbitrary SQL execution by unauthenticated callers.

ground_truth.rationale: True security vulnerability in active production route with direct untrusted attacker input.

finding.title: Hardcoded static administrative secret key in mock auth provider
finding.description: Static test credentials in mock authentication fixture used exclusively during offline unit tests.

ground_truth.rationale: Mock and test fixtures do not ship to production environments.

finding.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header on internal metric endpoint
finding.description: The internal /metrics endpoint does not emit max-age HSTS response headers.

ground_truth.rationale: Generic hygiene and missing best practice headers without exploitable impact.

finding.title: Unsanitized string interpolation in legacy deprecated logging branch
finding.description: Unescaped format string in function guarded by if False dead code conditional.

ground_truth.rationale: Unreachable dead code branch with no execution path from any application entrypoint.

finding.title: Client-side username length validation bypass
finding.description: HTML form maxlength attribute can be removed in browser devtools, but the backend API strictly enforces length limit.

ground_truth.rationale: Client-side only enforcement where backend server securely validates the constraint.

finding.title: Arbitrary file read via path traversal in report export handler
finding.description: Direct concatenation of filename parameter with base path allowing ../ traversal to read arbitrary system files.

ground_truth.rationale: True high-severity vulnerability reachable by remote callers.
